tools.name: street_create_enquiry
tools.description: WRITE: record a new inbound enquiry (a lead) in Street. Street matches the email address to an existing person or creates one, and the agency's own automations may then email or assign the lead. Street requires the enquiry to be tied to exactly one record: pass property_id, or sales_applicant_id, or

tools.name: street_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to one Street record (a person, property, applicant, sale, viewing, tenancy and so on). The note is visible to the agency's staff. Not idempotent: calling it twice adds two notes. POST /notes.

tools.name: street_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (to-do) in Street, optionally assigned to a user and given a task type. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two tasks. POST /todos.

tools.name: street_create_follow_up
tools.description: WRITE: schedule a follow-up on a property, sales or lettings applicant, sale or valuation. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two follow-ups. POST /follow-ups.

tools.name: street_create_maintenance_request
tools.description: WRITE: log a maintenance request against a property (a request, not a job: Street staff turn it into a job). Not idempotent: calling it twice logs two requests. POST /maintenance-requests.

tools.name: street_update_person
tools.description: WRITE: change a person's title, name, marketing consent or contact preferences in Street. Street requires both names on every update, so the current record is read first and anything you leave out is sent back unchanged. Contact details (email, phone, address) cannot be changed through the API. PATC

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: street_list_people, street_list_enquiries, street_update_person · Private data: street_get_property, street_list_people, street_get_person, street_get_vendor, street_get_landlord, street_get_tenant, street_get_sales_applicant, street_get_lettings_applicant, street_get_enquiry, street_get_viewing, street_get_valuation, street_list_sales, street_get_sale, street_get_sales_offer, street_get_lettings_offer, street_get_tenancy, street_get_maintenance_job, street_list_tasks, street_list_branches, street_get_branch, street_list_users, street_get_user, street_get_invoice, street_get_sales_instruction, street_get_lettings_instruction, street_get_inspection, street_get_interested_applicant, street_create_enquiry, street_create_note, street_update_person · Public sink: street_create_enquiry, street_create_note, street_create_task, street_create_follow_up, street_create_maintenance_request, street_update_person.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
